title: Digital licences and credentials collection notice
summary: This notice explains how Service NSW collects and uses personal information related to digital licences and credentials.

faqs.a: Information is collected to process your application for a digital licence or credential, or to support your use of it.

faqs.q: How will Service NSW contact me?
faqs.a: Service NSW may contact you to assist with administering your MyServiceNSW account and support the access and/or display of digital licence and credential information in the MyServiceNSW app, or to provide information relevant to the digital licences and credentials you have linked.

faqs.q: Can I access or correct my information?
faqs.a: You can access and seek correction of the personal information that Service NSW handles.
